title: Full open substacks inherit algebraicity
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], F an algebraic moduli stack over S [def-sfb-algebraic-moduli-stack], and U a full open substack of F [def-sfb-open-moduli-substack]. Then the full category selected by U, with its original projection to S-schemes, is an algebraic moduli stack. The atlas convention is a smooth surjective scheme atlas; the empty open is allowed.

source.place: Tag 05UN, lemma-open-fibred-category-is-algebraic, specialization to a full pullback-stable subcategory

proof.text: The full-subcategory projection preserves and reflects hom lifts: eliminate the witness of IsHomLift; both projections map the same arrow to the same base arrow. Lift the strongly cartesian universal property through fullness, using injectivity of the full inclusion to prove factorization and uniqueness. Ambient cartesian lifts stay in the subcategory because its predicate is closed under arrows. Thus the full subcategory is fibred in groupoids.

source.place: Tag 05UN, lemma-open-fibred-category-is-algebraic, specialization to a full pullback-stable subcategory

proof.text: Apply openStackAlgebraicLfp to the full inclusion. The fibredness hypothesis is the preceding construction, the target is algebraic by assumption, and the required scheme-valued open fibre equivalences are precisely U.open_pullback. Take the algebraicity conjunct of the resulting theorem. This includes the empty open without any nonemptiness hypothesis.
